description: Rust cargo: build and test commands, new crates and tools, publishing, and SQLx database commands.

rules.note: An upload of a crate to the registry, a yanked version, or a change of the crate owners.
`cargo add` adds a dependency. `cargo install NAME` downloads and builds a tool.
`cargo sqlx database drop` and `database reset` drop the database. `migrate revert` reverts the last migration.

safe.note: Build, test, lint, format, docs, benchmarks, and reads of the dependency tree. Tests, benchmarks, and build scripts are project code with a check or build contract. `cargo run` is not here: it runs a program of the project with any effect (dev round 3).

writes.note: `cargo sqlx migrate run`, `database create`, and `database setup` change the database.
